Definition: from G4862 and G1012; a consultor, i.e. adviser:--counsellor.
BiblicalUsage: Paul asks who has known the mind of the Lord, or who has been His counsellor, and the question answers itself: no one. God takes counsel from no one, and the wonder is that He still listens to His people when they pray.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that God needs no counsellor, and I hold that my wisest move is to stop advising Him and start listening to Him.
